prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Aluminium (Al) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her own room in a house of her element's kingdom, its walls and furniture built from the element's materials and colours, a mirror and a window
Weather / season: a rainy day — rain falls outside and streaks any window; surfaces are wet where she is outdoors.
Time of day: warm lamplight or candlelight indoors, the rest in shadow.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: an off-shoulder knit top slipping from one shoulder over shorts — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: sitting on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on her raised knee, her elbow on her knee.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
LEGS: one knee drawn up, the other leg resting flat.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — aluminium: a bright satin-silver metal so light it almost floats, the most common metal in the Earth's crust yet locked so tightly in clay and rust-red bauxite that it was once rarer than gold, laid only before an emperor's honoured guests, until electricity set it free; it shields itself in an invisible oxide skin that can be dyed soft anodized pastel colours; the skeleton of airships and aircraft, the humble can and kitchen foil of everyone; ruby and sapphire are nothing but coloured aluminium oxide; light, bright, cheerful and unpretentious — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: User authorized character completion and normal push to main

observations: 1024x1536; one adult woman; face and painterly rendering follow selected world reference.
Visible arms connect naturally to shoulders; no obvious extra or detached limb.
